A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we propose a technique for learning retriever models, based on attention scores of a downstream reader model, and we show that this approach is competitive with supervised methods, and even outperforms them in some settings.

, given a reader model for question answering, we can obtain a retriever model for question answering without using annotated pairs of questions and support documents, but using only a small set of annotated questions with answers.

the reader model is able to distill knowledge to the retriever.
the reader model can be used to distill knowledge from a retriever model, which in turn can be used to improve the retriever model.
